verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a table-to-HTML enrichment feature that converts detected tables into HTML markup using agentic AI or a VLM, which is directly relevant to table structure fidelity, but no evidence addresses handling of merged cells, nested headers, or tables spanning multiple pages — the specific complex-table scenarios in the story are unaddressed. missing for 10: evidence of merged-cell handling, nested header preservation, multi-page table stitching, and any accuracy benchmarks or independent validation of table fidelity.
